mechanism_claims.claim_text: Melittin disrupts and permeabilizes the X. oryzae pv. oryzae cell envelope under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: melittin against X. oryzae pv. oryzae strain ZJ-173
mechanism_claims.limitations: The microscopy and uptake assays support membrane damage/permeabilization in this pathogen, but do not by themselves quantify pore size or exclude additional intracellular effects.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Melittin binds X. oryzae pv. oryzae nucleic acids in vitro and can interfere with macromolecular synthesis context.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: melittin with extracted X. oryzae pv. oryzae DNA/RNA
mechanism_claims.limitations: DNA/RNA binding is direct in vitro evidence; intracellular target inhibition in living bacteria remains mechanistic interpretation rather than a separately quantified intracellular binding assay.
